ai.brain: One shinobi entity for every human enemy, drawn with VF's resident model and our wardrobe; animals are vanilla-based entities with our brain
band_rules: Each loadout prefers a band; the brain moves to it, strafes at 1.5 to 3 blocks a second and keeps a 30% chance to switch band every 4 s
Close: taijutsu chains, grabs and guard; mid: throws, D and C jutsu, dashes in; far: jutsu, bows, traps, sensing, retreat to heal
Two or more enemies coordinate bands: one presses close while the others hold mid or far (a cell is always one close, one far)

reactions.telegraph_factor: dodge chance x (telegraph ticks / 10), at most 1.5x: slow, readable attacks are dodged more
reactions.substitution: Genin and up substitute once per fight when a hit would take 20% of their health
reactions.kiting: a fighter that prefers a farther band backs off at 60% of its speed, and only on half its decisions: a closer catches it
reactions.retreat: retreat to heal at 30% health if they carry pills or a medic is near; rogue ninja use smoke to break off
reactions.flee: bandits flee at 25% health (chance in the loadout); a fleeing enemy that is hit again surrenders
reactions.flinch: a landed hit makes a mook or elite flinch: its wind-up is cancelled (bosses flinch only when their poise breaks); the player flinches too, except from light hits on Story
reactions.interrupt: melee hits, staggers and knockdowns interrupt a weave; a thrown or jutsu hit interrupts only if it deals 15% of the weaver's health or more (a single shuriken does not; a tagged kunai or a big jutsu does). Enemies weave only when no one is within 3 blocks, unless they are jonin

tells.rule: Every enemy attack has a wind-up pose and a sound, scaled by difficulty (telegraph_mult). Unblockables flash red (Story, Shinobi). Signs are visible as the enemy weaves

habits.how: The brain keeps a short memory of the player's habits in this fight (last 60 s) and adapts, scaled by difficulty's habit_adaptation; the sensei comments in barks

rules.when: the same technique 3 times in 30 s
rules.react: +15% dodge against it for each repeat; casters raise a counter-nature wall

rules.when: no block in 20 s while fighting
rules.react: more feints and fast light chains

rules.when: blocking more than 50% of the time
rules.react: guard breaks, grabs, paper bombs, wind (guard pierce)

rules.when: 4 dodges in a row the same way

rules.react: body flicker in, smoke, rushers lead
substitution, knockback jutsu, shove to mid
paper bombs over it, flanking, area jutsu
enemies press; casters stop holding back
unblockables and throws instead of melee

ai.attack_tokens: At most N enemies may attack the player in melee or with jutsu at once (Story 1, Shinobi 2, Hard 3; difficulty attack_tokens); the rest circle, throw, reposition or fight your teammates. Bosses always hold a token
ai.squad_ai: Enemy groups pick a leader; the leader calls a focus target (the weakest or the caster). Animals pack-hunt: they circle and bite from behind
ai.knockout: Residents and spar partners are knocked out, never killed (VF Knockouts). Bandits and rogue ninja can be knocked out or defeated; story enemies follow their boss file
